source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (register of licensed financial institutions, PDF series)
why_relevant: Legally mandated enumeration of every licensed bank, microfinance institution, non-bank financial institution, payment institution, e-money institution, insurer and pension fund in Kosovo. This is the closest thing to a complete buyer universe for banking/payments vendors in XK, and it is periodically re-issued as a dated PDF, so successive versions give entry/exit signal.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (SHBK) — Members page (AL)
why_relevant: Canonical enumeration of the commercial banks that constitute the Kosovo banking market — the buyer universe for any banking/payments vendor. Anchor list for actor mapping and for cross-referencing vendor case studies.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — Member Banks (EN mirror path)
why_relevant: English-language duplicate of the member roster; useful for entity-name normalization (Albanian vs English legal names) when matching vendors' reference lists.

source_name: STIKK – Kosovo ICT Association member directory
why_relevant: Co-founder of ICK and the umbrella body for Kosovo's ICT firms; its member directory surfaces the software houses and integrators that build payment apps and terminal software locally — the supplier side of the payments cell rather than the licensed side.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association member directory
why_relevant: THE enumeration of local ICT companies — 100+ members, the pool from which banking/payments integrators, resellers and implementation partners of foreign platforms are drawn. Tiering (Gold/Silver/Bronze/Basic) doubles as a sponsorship signal: Gold members fund the association.

source_name: Mobile app store listings as vendor fingerprints (Android package IDs / iOS publishers) for Kosovo banks
why_relevant: Store metadata leaks the digital-banking vendor even when neither bank nor vendor publishes a case study. NLB mKlik Kosova ships under package id hr.asseco.android.jimba.nlbpr (Asseco's 'Jimba' mobile banking product line, Croatia entity); ProCredit Kosovo apps ship under com.quipugmbh.* (Quipu). Systematically enumerating every Kosovo bank app gives a vendor map of the digital-banking layer.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — member directory (tiered: Patron/Corporate/Medium/Small)
why_relevant: Tiered membership is a paying-sponsor signal: Patron members are the largest corporates operating in Kosovo, typically including banks and technology firms. Also the main venue where US/international vendors surface locally.

source_name: AMIK — Association of Microfinance Institutions of Kosovo
why_relevant: Trade body for the MFI sector; publishes member lists, sector history and committee structure. Members identified include KEP Trust, FINCA Kosovë, KRK (Kreditimi Rural i Kosovës), AFK (Agjencioni për Financim në Kosovë), Besëlidhja and Kosinvest — a ready-made buyer list for core banking, digital lending, agent and collection technology.

source_name: AMIK — Anëtarët e AMIK (member MFIs)
why_relevant: Enumerates the ~12 microfinance institutions in Kosovo (KRK, AFK, FINCA Kosovë, KEP, Besëlidhja etc.) — the second-tier buyer segment for core-banking-lite, loan origination and payment acceptance solutions, usually invisible in bank-only lists.

source_name: Asseco SEE (ASEE) — case studies and company contacts, incl. ASSECO SEE SH.P.K. Kosovo
why_relevant: ASEE runs a registered Kosovo legal entity (ASSECO SEE SH.P.K., Rr. Lidhja e Pejës 177, Prishtina) and is the dominant regional supplier of digital banking, card, ATM/POS and PKI/e-signature software. The existence of a local entity plus the group's case-study library is the strongest structural pointer to an undisclosed Kosovo installed base; sibling case studies (e.g. Komercijalna banka BPS) show the format a Kosovo reference would take.

entity_name: Dun & Bradstreet business-directory profiles for Kosovo/regional IT subsidiaries
source_name: Dun & Bradstreet business-directory profiles for Kosovo/regional IT subsidiaries
why_relevant: D&B profiles exist for the Kosovo subsidiaries of regional integrators (Asseco SEE sh.p.k., Comtrade Computers sh.p.k., Nextsense d.o.o.) and give headcount, revenue estimate and corporate-family linkage — the quickest way to size a competitor's Kosovo presence when the vendor publishes nothing itself.

source_name: Balkan Insight — Prishtina desk (BIRN regional)
why_relevant: Regional aggregation of BIRN's Kosovo output; useful as a pointer to which Kosovo investigations BIRN considers regionally significant, and to cross-border vendor stories (Serbia/Albania/North Macedonia) that touch Kosovo banking.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare (OEGJK/KDWV) — full member list
why_relevant: ~200 members; the German-Kosovar chamber is the natural home of German/DACH technology and banking-software vendors entering Kosovo, plus their local partners. A downloadable member list (.docx) was indexed, implying a structured, harvestable roster.

source_name: Gjirafa.biz business directory — association & company entries
why_relevant: Kosovo's dominant local business directory; carries entries for the chambers/associations themselves and for member companies with categories and contacts. Serves as an aggregator fallback where association directories are bot-defended or unstructured.

source_name: Innovation Centre Kosovo (ICK) – startup portfolio and programmes
why_relevant: Kosovo's main incubator (founded by STIKK + Norwegian MFA); has run 28 business-idea calls including a dedicated FinTech edition and supported 500+ startups. The startups directory and programme pages (e.g. TechBoost) are the highest-yield pointer for discovering pre-licence payments startups before they reach press or the BQK register.

source_name: KosICT Technology Festival — speakers and sponsors
why_relevant: Kosovo's largest ICT festival (14th edition; 2,798 registered participants, 208 companies; 10-11 October 2025 at Tech Park Prishtina). ProCredit Bank Kosova is general sponsor and its Deputy CEO Bejtë Cakaj appears on the speaker list — a bank executive paired with a technology agenda. Exhibitor/company list is effectively a vendor roster for the market.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — procurement data projects
why_relevant: Civic-tech organisation that has repeatedly rebuilt and analysed Kosovo procurement datasets (including emergency procurement). Its writeups reveal dataset structures, field quirks and alternative endpoints, shortening the engineering path to reliable collection.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo – 'Bizneset e Hapura' / Open Businesses
why_relevant: Civil-society platform holding ~170k ARBK-derived business records; documents the scraping methodology and is a snapshot source useful for historical comparison (when did a vendor entity first appear).

source_name: Wikipedia (sr) — 'Kriza na severu Kosova i Metohije' and related bank entries
why_relevant: Not evidence in itself, but a dense, dated citation index into Serbian-language primary reporting on the north-Kosovo crisis including the dinar/payment measures; efficient snowballing seed for actors and terminology.

source_name: Adria Media Group — 'Digitalno bankarstvo i osiguranje' expo zone (exhibitor directory)
why_relevant: A structured virtual expo directory for Serbian/regional digital banking and insurance — effectively a machine-readable exhibitor and sponsor roster, the single densest sr-language vendor list found in this cell.

source_name: Balkan Fintech Association
why_relevant: Regional fintech body whose co-founder (Linda Shomo) speaks at Kosovo fintech events; likely publishes member lists, events and partner rosters spanning XK/AL/MK/RS — a regional overlay on the Kosovo partnership map.

source_name: BKS — Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit (Kosovo Insurance Bureau)
why_relevant: Bureau/association covering Kosovo's ~14 licensed insurers (12 non-life, 2 life). Insurers are adjacent buyers of premium-collection, card-on-file and agent-network payment technology; motor insurance is also sold and paid through payment agents such as Capital Ria. Member list is the actor map for the insurance leg of this cell.

source_name: CBCG FinTech Hub / FinTech Hackathon (Montenegro) — regional template and sponsor roster
why_relevant: Central-bank-run fintech hackathon in the Western Balkans, co-run with ICT Cortex and hosted on TAIKAI. Sponsor/partner and challenge lists show which vendors court regional central banks; a close analogue and likely template for any future BQK-side initiative, and Kosovo teams may participate.

source_name: European Digital Finance Association — event listings for Balkan payments events
why_relevant: Aggregator/partner listing that mirrors Balkan payments event descriptions, partner lists and dates; useful as a redundant pointer when organiser sites are rebuilt between editions.

source_name: Fintechnews.ch — European fintech events calendar (regional discovery)
why_relevant: Editorial calendar of continental European fintech events used to discover new regional forums that Kosovo/WB banks and their vendors attend; a cheap way to find events not yet indexed locally.

source_name: Gjirafa — job search vertical
why_relevant: Gjirafa is the dominant Albanian-language search engine and its jobs vertical indexes vacancies across many Kosovo boards, including small/company-site-only postings. Best used as a meta-search pointer for discovering boards and employers outside the known set.

source_name: KosICT 2025 B2B Matchmaking participant list (b2match)
why_relevant: Structured, per-company participation records for the festival's matchmaking event — each participant page states company, country and cooperation profile. Reveals foreign vendors actively hunting Kosovo channel partners.

source_name: Kosinfo — aggregator of Serbian-language Kosovo media
why_relevant: Single aggregation point over Radio Goraždevac, Radio Kim, Radio Kontakt Plus, KoSSev, Radio Mitrovica sever, Gračanica Online, RTV Mir, RTV Puls and others — the fastest way to enumerate and monitor the whole Serbian-language Kosovo outlet set without discovering each separately.

source_name: KosovoProjects.eu — EU-funded project database for Kosovo
why_relevant: One-stop database of EU-funded projects in Kosovo with fact sheets, beneficiaries, duration and implementing partners — the fastest way to enumerate which IPA projects touch the financial sector and who implements them.

source_name: Media Ownership Monitor — Kosovo
why_relevant: Meta-source: maps who owns each Kosovo outlet and its political/commercial affiliations. Essential for weighting credibility of the media candidates in this cell — e.g. distinguishing advertorial-driven portals from independent investigative ones, and spotting when a bank's owner also owns the outlet reporting on it.

entity_name: NLB Komercijalna banka / Serbian-language north-Kosovo banking coverage
source_name: NLB Komercijalna banka / Serbian-language north-Kosovo banking coverage (planplus.rs, nirapress.com)
why_relevant: Serbian-language directories and outlets are the only practical trace of ATM/branch presence and dual-currency withdrawal arrangements in Serb-majority municipalities, and of the 2024 Komercijalna banka branch closures that reshaped the northern ATM estate.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (KCC/OEK) — sectoral associations & member base
why_relevant: The statutory chamber: 30 sectoral associations and 15,000+ members. Its ICT/financial-services sectoral associations and regional units (Prishtinë, Mitrovicë, Pejë, Prizren, Gjakovë, Ferizaj, Gjilan) are a broad but shallow pointer layer for identifying smaller local suppliers.

source_name: Open Banking Tracker — Kosovo (XK) provider & API directory
why_relevant: Enumerates the ~15 Kosovo banks with their digital/API footprints — the canonical target list against which to run all hiring and app-store monitoring, and an early indicator of which institutions have developer-facing API programmes (i.e. a modern channel platform).

source_name: OpenCorporates.al — Albanian company register mirror (NIPT lookups)
why_relevant: Albanian-language registry data resolves the legal identity, ownership and name changes of Albanian entities of regional integrators (e.g. Intracom Telecom Albania, ex-Intralban). Essential for de-duplicating aliases and for tracing which Albanian entity actually fronts Kosovo work.

source_name: Security Code Kosova — private security / secure cash transport services
why_relevant: Local licensed private-security operator advertising secure money transport — an actor in the ATM replenishment / CIT supply chain that banks outsource to; service pages help map the CIT competitor set.

source_name: ShpalljePune.com — active Kosovo vacancy aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator of currently-active Kosovo competitions; acts as a discovery pointer to employers and to boards not yet on the collection list, and helps catch postings before deadline removal.

source_name: Thales CPL partner directory (regional integrator listings)
why_relevant: OEM partner directories are the most reliable way to enumerate which Balkan integrators are certified to resell payment-security, HSM and authentication products — a proxy for who can credibly bid on Kosovo bank security/payments work. Searchable by country.

source_name: TheKYB – Kosovo business registry data (commercial KYB provider)
why_relevant: Commercial KYB feed claiming real-time Kosovo registry coverage; relevant as a fallback bulk-access route and as evidence of which registry fields are machine-available (status, officers, addresses).
